g.title: j1011564086
g.text: Hey Aoi! You like Amir, right?

g.title: j2369235301
g.text: You're a fan of games, right Aoi?

g.title: j1682996578
g.text: Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a board game where everybody makes characters and plays pretend.

g.title: j474354951
g.text: Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a game where we all tell a story together and use chance to add some excitement to it.

g.title: j2633064853
g.text: like what kind of play pretend? ... r people gonna make fun of me for playing?

g.title: j3386720686
g.text: count me in!! oh oh oh do you think he'll let me play a character that has pets?

g.title: j4162302254
g.text: Eh, it's just a silly game. It's a waste of time but I'm trying to be nice.

g.title: j275787347
g.text: If they do, they'll have to go through me. <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>

g.title: j1356171717
g.text: Who cares? It'll be fun! And it'll mean a lot to Amir.

g.title: j3755623714
g.text: LOL. I think you can play as a druid, yeah. They have familiars. Like cats and things.

g.title: j2711722244
g.text: i think it'll mean the world to amir to have everybody around the table playing... he's like me. big heart <3
